title: The aim
text: Everyone starts at level one. The first to reach level ten wins, and the tenth level must come from beating a monster.

title: Setting up
text: Deal each player four Door cards and four Treasure cards. Play any items you like in front of you straight away.

title: A turn
text:
First, kick open the door: turn the top Door card face up. A monster must be fought. A curse lands on you. Anything else goes into your hand.

If there was no monster, you may either look for trouble by fighting a monster from your hand, or loot the room by drawing a Door card face down.

Last comes charity: if you hold more than five cards, give the extras to the lowest-level player.

title: Fighting
text:
Add your level to the bonuses on your items. If your total is higher than the monster's level, you win, go up a level and draw its treasures. A tie is a loss.

Any other player may make it harder for you with cards, and one player may help you for whatever bribe you can agree.

title: Running away
text: If you cannot win, roll a die. On a five or a six you escape. Otherwise the monster's Bad Stuff happens to you, exactly as its card says.

title: Items
text: You may wear one headgear, one armour and one footgear, and use two hands' worth of things. Items worth a thousand gold between them can be sold for a level, though never the tenth.

title: What I do not carry
text: The cards carry their own rules and often contradict the general ones. When they do, the card wins.
